targets.old_statement: When traffic conditions or law prevent changing lanes to pass a bicycle, the passing vehicle must keep at least 3 feet away from the bicycle throughout the maneuver.
targets.old_spoken_statement: When traffic conditions or law prevent changing lanes to pass a bicycle, the passing vehicle must keep at least three feet away from the bicycle throughout the maneuver.
targets.statement: When changing lanes to pass a bicycle is impossible, unlawful, or unsafe, slow to a reasonable speed for traffic that is at least ten miles per hour under the posted limit or twenty-five miles per hour, whichever is higher, while keeping at least three feet of clearance at all times.
